name: Geist Mono
summary: Monospace typeface built for coding environments, variable from 100 to 900 with italics, free to download.
description: Geist Mono is a monospace typeface for readability in coding environments, made by Vercel with Basement Studio and paired with the Geist sans-serif family. It ships as a variable font with a 100-900 weight axis plus a matching italic, covering Latin, Latin Extended, Cyrillic and Vietnamese. Free under the SIL Open Font License.
contains: weights 100-900 plus italics as one variable font (wght axis)
subsets: latin, latin-ext, cyrillic, cyrillic-ext, vietnamese, symbols2
made by Vercel with Basement Studio for code editors
